pages.title: Curling Iron Development – José Vidal
pages.description: Curling iron heating barrel and control board development. Designed by José Vidal.
pages.extraCss:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../css/project.css">
		<style>
			/* ── Curler page: hero image — bottom-anchored absolute overlay ── */
			.project-hero {
				height: 80vh;
				overflow: visible;
				position: relative;
				padding: 0;
			}
			.project-hero__inner {
				display: flex;
				align-items: center;
				height: 100%;
				grid-template-columns: unset;
				gap: unset;
				max-width: 1100px;
				margin: 0 auto;
				padding: 0 48px;
			}
			.project-hero__text {
				max-width: 55%;
			}
			.project-hero__img-wrap {
				position: absolute;
				right: 25%;
				bottom: 0;
				height: 95%;
				width: auto;
			}
			.project-hero__img {
				height: 100%;
				width: auto;
				display: block;
				object-position: bottom center;
				mix-blend-mode: lighten;
			}
			/* ── Section label utility (replaces per-element inline styles) ── */
			.section-label {
				font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif;
				font-size: 0.75rem;
				font-weight: 600;
				letter-spacing: 0.14em;
				text-transform: uppercase;
				color: #cb4444;
				display: block;
				margin-bottom: 1rem;
			}
			.section-header {
				margin-bottom: 1rem;
			}
			.section-header .section-label {
				margin-bottom: 0;
			}
			.problem-statement h2::before {
				display: none;
			}
			/* ── Heater config comparison grid ── */
			.heater-compare-grid {
				display: grid;
				grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
				gap: 1.25rem;
				margin-bottom: 2rem;
			}
			.hconfig-card {
				background: #fff;
				border-radius: 10px;
				border: 2px solid #e8e8e8;
				overflow: hidden;
				box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
			}
			.hconfig-card--selected {
				border-color: #cb4444;
			}
			.hconfig-header {
				padding: 1.125rem 1.25rem 1rem;
				border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
			}
			.hconfig-header h4 {
				font-size: 1rem;
				margin: 0.35rem 0 0.35rem;
				color: #111;
			}
			.hconfig-header p {
				font-size: 0.8rem;
				color: #888;
				margin: 0;
				line-height: 1.4;
			}
			.hconfig-verdict {
				font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
				font-size: 0.65rem;
				font-weight: 600;
				letter-spacing: 0.1em;
				text-transform: uppercase;
				padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
				border-radius: 4px;
				display: inline-block;
				margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
			}
			.hconfig-verdict--selected { background: rgba(203,68,68,0.1); color: #cb4444; }
			.hconfig-verdict--considered { background: #f0f0f0; color: #777; }
			.hconfig-verdict--rejected { background: #f0f0f0; color: #aaa; }
			.hconfig-images {
				display: flex;
				gap: 0.5rem;
				padding: 0.875rem;
				background: #fafafa;
			}
			.hconfig-images img {
				flex: 1;
				width: 0;
				max-height: 180px;
				object-fit: contain;
				border-radius: 5px;
				background: #fff;
			}
			.hconfig-metrics {
				padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
			}
			.hconfig-metrics p {
				font-size: 0.82rem;
				color: #666;
				line-height: 1.55;
				margin: 0;
			}
			.hconfig-delta {
				font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
				font-size: 1.75rem;
				color: #111;
				line-height: 1;
				margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
			}
			.hconfig-card--selected .hconfig-delta { color: #cb4444; }
			@media (max-width: 768px) {
				.heater-compare-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
				.decision-cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; gap: 1.5rem !important; }
			}
			@media (max-width: 768px) {
				.project-hero {
					height: auto;
					min-height: 70vw;
					overflow: visible;
				}
				.project-hero__inner {
					height: auto;
					align-items: center;
				}
				.project-hero__text {
					max-width: 55%;
					padding-bottom: 3rem;
				}
				.project-hero__img-wrap {
					position: absolute;
					right: 0;
					top: 0;
					bottom: 0;
					height: 100%;
					width: 45%;
				}
				.problem-cols {
					grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
					gap: 1.5rem !important;
				}
			}
		</style>
